newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE to scamper back towards 4,350.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE to scamper back towards 4,350.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index may scamper back towards 4,350 on Monday as the spectre of a further retreat on Wall Street looms over the market, technical analysts said.

The banks and utilities sectors which had helped the FTSE climb higher last week will take a back seat today but some insurance shares may pick up the slack -- though not enough to prevent an overall market weakness, they added.
By 0823 GMT, the FTSE was indicated down 6.5 at 4,363.2.
The market hit a ceiling at about 4,390 on a closing basis and seemed unable to find the resources to mount one last attack at a record high before the month end.
And a dissapointing session on Wall Street on Friday -- in which the Dow closed down 53.38 points lower at 6,738.87 -- will provide ammunition for the bears to try to launch an offensive in London.
But despite the negative sentiment, the FTSE will not over-react to Wall Street's decline and a cushion may be found at 4,350 and its upside may be restricted to 4,375, analysts said.
